'''Tsodrelle'Aman''' is the name of the lake formed in the city of [[Rhuidean]] after [[Rand al'Thor]] brought water to the sacred [[Aiel]] city by splitting the Earth down to a vast underground aquifer, a side-effect of his struggle with [[Asmodean]] for the [[Access Key]]. Its name translates to "Tears of the Dragon," although [[Aviendha]] thinks it should be called "Tears of the Aiel."
